name: Bitcoin 0.8 chain fork
rootCause: Bitcoin 0.8 switched from BerkeleyDB to LevelDB. A large block exceeded BerkeleyDB lock limits in 0.7 nodes, so 0.7 rejected it and 0.8 accepted it, splitting the chain. Miners coordinated a downgrade; one merchant lost ~$10k to a double-spend. (BIP 50, CVE-2013-3220)
